title: Grateful Dead Live at Marin County Veterans Auditorium on 1984-03-31
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell XLIIS-90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording featuring a trippy performance of He's Gone.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the clarity and quality of this soundboard source, calling it a nice upgrade over other board and audience recordings. The highlight of the show is a “trippy” rendition of He’s Gone, suggesting a strong musical moment despite the lack of detailed set commentary.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review emphasizes both superb sound quality and an outstanding performance of He’s Gone, leading to a high rating but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix; reviewer notes the sound is superior to other board and audience sources.
